'''Energy capacitors''' were components used in weapons,<ref name="EGWT" /> and also as hand-held tools.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> The energy capacitors used in the [[MAS-2xB]] mobile [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] were wrapped in [[cryogenic cylinder]]s to stop them overheating during use.<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Dardrennis Survival Technology]] manufactured the [[EMS-500]], a hand-held tool energy capacitor.<ref name="GFT" />
